notes.welcome.title: Welcome to Notes
notes.welcome.content:
# Notes Workspace
This is where MomAI keeps your structured memory.

## How it works
When you ask me to save something, I can create and organize notes for you here automatically.

## What you can do
- **Organize ideas:** Write with Markdown support, including headings, lists, and emphasis.
- **Drag and drop:** Import and export `.md` files using the folder button above.
- **Ask for summaries:** You can ask in chat things like "What do my notes say about X?" and I can summarize quickly.

> Tip: Right-click a note in the sidebar to rename it.

You're all set.

splash.tip.desc.0: Customize your experience by toggling between Light and Dark themes in settings.
splash.tip.desc.1: Choose from different voices and languages so MomAI fits you perfectly.
splash.tip.desc.2: You can enable or disable the Wake Word in settings to call the assistant only when you want. Say "Luna" to call MomAI.
splash.tip.desc.3: Add heavy programs to Power Saver to optimize AI performance via FortScript.
splash.tip.desc.4: Ask MomAI for reminders and request information about your appointments at any time.
splash.tip.desc.5: Write quick ideas in the notes tab and ask the assistant to analyze them for you.
splash.tip.desc.6: MomAI operates 100% locally. Your audio and text data never leave your computer.
splash.tip.desc.7: The side panel opens automatically to display maps, tables, or detailed lists.
splash.tip.desc.8: The assistant uses vector memory to remember facts and preferences in the long term.
splash.tip.desc.9: The assistant can search for up-to-date information on the internet using DuckDuckGo.
